criteria.criterion: docs/spec.toml entry OLY-B-GOAL-03 has a mechanism naming existing paths (crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs and crates/athena-core/src/status.rs) instead of "none", keeps owner Athena, and a measure ending `status: forecasts`; check by Grep of docs/spec.toml.
criteria.evidence: Grep of docs/spec.toml lines 2089-2093: the mechanism names build_reading in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs, go_job in crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs, crates/athena-gate/src/invariant.rs and class_forecasts in crates/athena-core/src/status.rs. owner = "Athena". The measure ends "; status: forecasts". I read each named item in the code: build_reading at reading.rs:767, go_job at run/mod.rs:431 (it dispatches only a Proposed job's latest reading), invariant.rs:627-763 (the reading must be recorded before dispatch), and class_forecasts at status.rs:982. The new test passed. Athena's revert run failed it with exit 101 on the base spec.

criteria.criterion: STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS in crates/athena-core/src/status.rs contains ("forecasts", "forecasts") and the `athena status` display prints a line starting with that label (crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs); check by Grep and diff.
criteria.evidence: The diff adds ("forecasts", "forecasts") to STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS (status.rs:319). The new forecast_headline_lines in display.rs holds the literal "forecasts   ", and status() calls it in place of the old inline loop. The output is byte-identical to before: the old `{label:<11} ` and the new 12-character literal both give 12 characters. Both tests passed. Real records in the evidence snapshot hold many score.json files, so live `athena status` prints this line. I did not run status itself on them.

criteria.criterion: A new test fails without the mechanism and passes with it: it builds a reading without or with forecasts before dispatch (or a status view with scored forecasts) and asserts the forecast is present/committed and that the `forecasts` line is printed; run `cargo test` and confirm the test passes, and that removing the forecast makes it fail.
criteria.evidence: All three new tests passed. The reading test runs the real build_reading and asserts the reader forecast values carried into Reading.forecasts and a valid reference forecast. It also asserts that the same reading with the `forecast` key removed is refused ('parsing the reading'). The display test asserts the first row starts `forecasts   docs: 3 scored ...`. Athena's fails-without-1 run shows the spec test failing (exit 101) with the spec entry reverted. The reading test passed on the reverted tree because build_reading is pre-existing code that was not reverted. It pins that behavior, and its own removal of the forecast shows the refusal.

criteria.criterion: `cargo test` (including every_measure_label_names_a_status_view_field_and_a_printed_line and the xtask spec test), `cargo clippy` and `cargo fmt --check` all pass.
criteria.evidence: Athena recorded fmt, clippy and test as passing for 25fa4c82a388 in CI run 43160423250. I also ran the xtask spec suite (30 passed, including the_real_spec_passes and every_active_requirement_has_a_mechanism_an_owner_and_a_measure) and the label test (passed).

findings.summary: The label test can be satisfied by the display test's own string literal.
findings.evidence: every_measure_label_names_a_status_view_field_and_a_printed_line checks only that display.rs contains `"forecasts `. The new display test's expected row `"forecasts   docs: ...` (in display.rs's test module) also matches, so the label test would pass even if the production literal were removed. The new forecast_headline test does cover the production helper, so nothing is unshown.

findings.summary: The refusal assertion in the reading test is generic.
findings.evidence: It checks only that the error contains 'parsing the reading', which any deserialization failure produces. Removing only `forecast` makes the cause clear here, but asserting the error names the missing `forecast` field would be tighter.

summary: The change passes. OLY-B-GOAL-03 in docs/spec.toml now names a mechanism that exists in the code: build_reading commits the reader's forecast and a reference forecast, go_job dispatches only a committed reading, invariant.rs requires the reading to come before dispatch, and class_forecasts scores the forecasts per class. Owner stays Athena, and the measure ends `status: forecasts`. "forecasts" is added to STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS. The forecasts rows of `athena status` move into a helper, forecast_headline_lines, and print the same text as before. I ran the three new tests (spec entry, reading forecast, display rows), the label test and the xtask spec suite; all passed. Athena's revert run shows the spec test failing without the spec change. fmt, clippy and the full test suite are recorded as passing in CI. All five changed files are on the expected list, and the approach reuses the existing forecast path, which is sound. Two minor test-strength notes remain: the label test can be satisfied by a string in a test, and the refusal assertion matches any parse error.
